A1 [Y]: A dataset-specific stable repository/deposit and the assessed release are identified; this is inventory identity, not verified retrieval.

A2 [U]: A usable route to the assessed release is not established by the available source snapshot.

A3 [Y]: Data terms are explicitly recorded for the selected release. This does not clear upstream-component rights or intended-use compatibility.

L1 [Y]: The saved source describes the available targets and their meaning for this released task; no quality premium is assigned to boxes or masks.

L2 [U]: The source packet does not jointly establish a target encoding and basic labeling/measurement procedure.

L4 [U]: No concrete target-review/correction/verification practice is established; multiple annotators, publication, file availability or generic quality claims alone do not qualify.

D1 [Y]: The recorded package structure, format and target mapping provide file-interpretation evidence; payload correctness remains untested.

D2 [U]: The collector/compiler and collection method or specific parent lineage remain insufficiently established.

D4 [Y]: Dataset-specific intended scope, selection exclusions or collection/annotation limitations are described in the source summary.

C1 [Y]: The saved evidence reports a released count with a stated observation unit; this does not establish independent captures.

C2 [Y]: The source reports quantitative class/outcome/subset accounting relevant to the documented task. It is not proof of statistical balance or independence.

R1 [U]: Collection geography/site, pavement context or capture setting is missing or unresolved; author affiliation is not collection geography.

R2 [Y]: The source describes collection variation or an explicit restricted scope; breadth itself earns no bonus.

M1 [U]: Collection platform/sensor or data-generation method is unreported or only inferred from the title.

M2 [U]: Task-relevant resolution/sampling/measurement units are absent or only generically described; physical scale does not substitute for unspecified image dimensions in the image profile.

M5 [U]: No concrete transformations or explicit unprocessed-data statement are established.
